$comment: Storybook ids and URLs that changed when components moved to Atlassian categories and display names. Old ids read from the live index.json before the change; new ids from Storybook's own id rule (scripts/lib/storybook-id.mjs). One row per docs page or story. Use it to rewrite links (Notion, Figma, Slack) that point at an old id or name an old title (a title whose id did not change, such as Date & time picker, is in titles but not entries). Delete this file once those links are rewritten.
